title: Mera Mera no Mi
facts: Logia-type Devil Fruit, English name Flame-Flame Fruit
User can create, control and become fire; Logia bodies let ordinary attacks pass through, Haki can hit them
Techniques: Hiken (Fire Fist), Hotarubi Hidaruma (Fire Flies), Dai Enkai Entei (Flame Emperor)
Known users: Portgas D. Ace ('Fire Fist Ace'); after his death the fruit reappeared as the Corrida Colosseum prize, won and eaten by his sworn brother Sabo
Like all Devil Fruit users, the user cannot swim

scenes.text: Imagine you eat the *Mera* *Mera* no Mi.
scenes.say: Imagine you eat the, Mehra Mehra no Mee.

scenes.text: It's a *Logia* type Devil Fruit, the *Flame-Flame* Fruit.
scenes.say: It's a Lohgia type devil fruit. The flame, flame fruit.
Your body can create, control, and become fire.

scenes.text: Swords and bullets pass right *through* you, unless they use *Haki.*
scenes.say: Swords and bullets pass right through you. Unless they use, Hah-kee.

scenes.text: *Fire* *Fist!* Blast a huge column of flame from your fist.
scenes.say: Fire fist! Blast a huge column of flame from your fist.
Fire flies! Glowing fireballs, that explode on contact.

scenes.text: *Flame* *Emperor!* A giant *sun* of fire you hurl at your enemies.
scenes.say: Flame emperor! A giant sun of fire, you hurl at your enemies.

scenes.text: Its famous user was *Portgas* *D.* *Ace,* known as *Fire* *Fist* Ace.
scenes.say: Its famous user was, Portgas Dee Ace. Known as, fire fist Ace.

scenes.text: After Ace died, his brother *Sabo* won it at the *Colosseum* and ate it.
scenes.say: After Ace died, his brother, Sah-bo, won it at the colosseum, and ate it.

scenes.text: The catch? Like every Devil Fruit user, you can *never* *swim* again.
scenes.say: The catch? Like every devil fruit user, you can never swim again.

scenes.text: So... would *you* eat the *Mera* *Mera* no Mi?
scenes.say: So. Would you eat the, Mehra Mehra no Mee?
